message: All 7 waiver-candidates.jsonl rows (WVR-001..007) use review_status='proposed', but the waiver-candidate/v1 schema requires review_status ∈ {pending, approved, rejected} per go-skill-v9-validate line 636. go-skill-v9-validate flags each row as E_WAIVER_LIFECYCLE_INVALID. The rows are well-formed in every other field (boundary_proof, compensating_evidence, owner, expiry 2026-12-31, behavior_affecting=false).
required_fix: Update each waiver row's review_status from 'proposed' to 'pending'. The state machine will then advance rows to 'approved' or 'rejected' at the formal-verifier stage. The schema mismatch is non-blocking for proof-writer because no row is promoted to formal-waiver at this state.
approval_ref: debt recorded in proof-plan-findings.jsonl F-003; correct in next planner iteration
rationale: The waivers are non-behavior-affecting documentation; the lifecycle-state mismatch is a schema-strictness issue that does not affect the active obligations. Approved as debt to be corrected when the planner next iterates on this bead.

message: Lane coverage is incomplete per go-skill-v9-validate's required_verifiers_for_seed() function for ~40 (req, cc, proof_seed_id, verifier) tuples that have no VLD row. The 10 VLD rows cover (a) the 5 active proptest lanes (VLD-001..005) paired with 5 obligations and (b) 5 omitted-verifier lanes (VLD-006..010) at one (req, cc) tuple each. The remaining tuples — for example (REQ-CAP-002, CC-CAP-002, PS-CAP-PROPTEST-001, kani) — lack explicit not_applicable rows. go-skill-v9-validate flags these as E_LANE_DECISION_MISSING.
required_fix: Add not_applicable VLD rows for each (req, cc, seed, verifier) tuple not currently covered. The rationale is identical to the existing 5 VLD-006..010 rows (no new exec fn; const alias or pure encoder). This is a documentation completeness fix, not a coverage gap.
approval_ref: debt recorded in proof-plan-findings.jsonl F-004; correct in next planner iteration
rationale: The planner's intent (no formal Verus/Kani/Flux for this bead) matches the user's directive 'numeric/cap refinement only (no formal Verus/Kani/Flux)' and is documented in §3 of the strategy. The 5 active obligations are well-formed and paired with VLD rows; proof-writer has enough information to proceed. The lane-coverage gap is a documentation debt that does not block proof-writer.
